aboutPage.pageSubtitle: IT Specialist with 20+ years in infrastructure, networking, and cybersecurity paired with practical AI model consulting
content: I am an IT professional with over 20 years of hands-on experience in systems, hardware, networking, cybersecurity, and advanced technical support. From my early days assembling and optimizing over 500 workstations, configuring 50+ LAN/WAN networks, and diagnosing critical failures, my focus has always been understanding technology from physical hardware up to system logic and artificial intelligence.

Over the years, my profile evolved holistically: on top of a rock-solid hardware and infrastructure foundation, I added multi-platform system administration (Windows, Linux, macOS), network engineering (Cisco CCNA 1–3), technical cybersecurity (Google Cybersecurity and FUNDAE 2025), and corporate cloud data restructuring (200+ GB in SharePoint and OneDrive).

My engineering principle is strict: I do not build improvised workarounds or chase tech hype. Every recommendation is driven by operational stability, resource optimization, data privacy, and measurable cost-benefit for the business.

In the Artificial Intelligence domain, I advise companies and professionals on integrating AI models (cloud or local LLMs, automated workflows, and document assistants) on secure foundations. 90% of AI adoption failures stem from messy data, vulnerable networks, or poor hardware investments—the exact three domains I have spent two decades solving.

In recent engagements as Senior IT Consultant at MASMEL Rehabilitaciones y Reformas and Level 2 Specialist at Mundofabian.com, I achieved a 95% first-contact resolution rate, a 25% reduction in monthly downtime, a 40% improvement in cloud file retrieval, and a 20% reduction in staff onboarding time through standardized documentation.
I value clarity, technical ethics, and complete transparency. There is no smoke or magic promises here: just proven field engineering and lasting results.
aboutPage.closing: I don't implement AI or technology for trends, but for technical judgment, security, and real return.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Direct, zero-smoke answers on how I integrate AI, infrastructure, and security

items.question: Why hire an Infrastructure and Cybersecurity specialist for AI advisory?
items.answer: Because AI doesn't live in a vacuum: it connects to your cloud files, runs on your workstations, traverses your network, and handles private client data. With 20+ years in systems, networking (CCNA), and cybersecurity (Google / FUNDAE), I ensure the AI you adopt is cost-effective, fast, and doesn't open security breaches.

items.question: How does working with you benefit me compared to hiring multiple separate agencies?
items.answer: You avoid the classic blame game where the AI consultant blames IT, IT blames the network, and nothing gets solved. I cover the entire chain end-to-end: from hardware, OS, and networking up to SharePoint/OneDrive structuring and AI model integration.

items.question: Can you audit our current infrastructure before introducing AI tools?
items.answer: Yes, and that is my standard protocol. I perform a technical diagnostic evaluating your workstations, cloud data structure, security posture, and specific operational workflows where an AI model or automation will deliver immediate return.

items.question: What kind of practical AI and automation solutions do you implement?
items.answer: I implement high-impact solutions: cloud knowledge structuring for private AI assistants, automated n8n and API workflows, AI-assisted operational manuals and support protocols, and objective evaluations between local models (total privacy) vs. cloud models like Claude or ChatGPT Enterprise.

items.question: Do you also handle critical day-to-day IT support, networking, and workstation issues?
items.answer: Absolutely. I maintain a 95% first-contact resolution rate across Windows, Linux, and macOS systems, router/switch configurations, network printers, and cloud migrations. A company cannot innovate with AI if daily operations halt due to technical failures.

items.question: Do you offer unbiased advice for purchasing computers, GPUs, or renewing company hardware?
items.answer: Yes. Having assembled and repaired 500+ workstations and advised 150+ clients, I analyze your real workloads so you buy exactly what you need—achieving 30% cost reductions and extending hardware lifespan by 3+ years.
